About

Founder-led SEO for ambitious brands.

Shahab Abbasi is a digital marketing agency built around one founder, Shahab Abbasi, and a lean specialist team that has scaled 50+ brands across 30+ countries since 2018. We engineer organic, AI search, and paid pipelines tied to revenue.

50+

Brands scaled

5,000+

Keywords on page 1

180%

Avg client revenue lift

What we do differently

  • - Founder works on every account. No junior account manager filtering between you and the strategist.
  • - ROI in 90 days or we work free until we hit the agreed benchmark.
  • - AI search visibility is a core deliverable - not a buzzword. We track ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews citations.
  • - Zero lock-in contracts. You can leave any month. Most do not.
  • - Transparent reporting tied to pipeline metrics, not vanity traffic.

Industries and stages

We work best with B2B SaaS, e-commerce DTC, professional services (legal, healthcare, finance), home services, and ambitious startups raising or scaling revenue. We do not pitch and dump - we partner with founders who want to compound results.

Next step

Outrank your competitors. Permanently.

Book a 30-minute strategy call. We will share a full audit, traffic forecast, and a 90-day plan tailored to your business. No pitch, just a plan.
